mutations.because: the for-await over listing pages breaks after its first page, so an object on a later page never reaches the aggregate. `reconcile keeps an orphan prefix whose fresh object arrives on a later page` plants a fresh C1 render on page 3 and asserts expect(plan.prefixes).toEqual([{ campaignId: C2, objects: 1 }]), which fails because the stale C1 (not C2) is planned.
command: reconcile keeps an orphan prefix whose fresh object arrives on a later page

mutations.because: a fresh object marks the campaign stale instead of fresh, so it no longer protects it: the fresh C1 render on page 3 leaves group.fresh false and C1 is planned. `reconcile keeps an orphan prefix whose fresh object arrives on a later page` asserts expect(plan.prefixes).toEqual([{ campaignId: C2, objects: 1 }]), which fails because C1 appears too.
command: reconcile keeps an orphan prefix whose fresh object arrives on a later page

mutations.because: the fake answers in one page: it yields the whole remainder and then stops, so five objects with listPageSize 2 come back as a single page. `listPages yields pages no larger than the page size` asserts expect(pages.map((page) => page.length)).toEqual([2, 2, 1]), which fails on that assertion line.
command: listPages yields pages no larger than the page size

mutations.because: the cap check is removed, so a prefix holding more keys than deletePrefixMaxKeys is no longer refused and deletePrefix resolves instead of rejecting. `deletePrefix refuses a prefix holding more keys than the cap and deletes nothing` has await expect(operation).rejects.toThrow("Refusing deletePrefix"), which fails on that rejects assertion line.
command: deletePrefix refuses a prefix holding more keys than the cap and deletes nothing

mutations.because: the for-await over listPages breaks after the first page, so objects on later pages are never counted. `cache expiry counts entries on every page` plants an expired, a young and an unrecognised entry (each on its own page) and asserts expect(plan).toEqual({ orgId: "local", expired: [D1], kept: 1, unrecognised: 1 }), which fails on that line.
command: cache expiry counts entries on every page
